summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a 6-K attaching its November 5, 2026 news release disclosing fiscal Q2 2027 results and confirming a November 3, 2026 definitive Arrangement Agreement under which Organigram Global will acquire all Aurora shares via a BC statutory plan of arrangement. Consideration per share is C$7.80 cash, 5.8626 Organigram shares, or C$3.75 cash plus 3.0431 Organigram shares, subject to proration. Expected completion is January 2027, pending shareholder, court and regulatory approvals; a Special Meeting is expected in December 2026. Watch proration elections, election mix and regulatory timing.
